item.title: Start Here — Data Science & AI on dasarpAI
item.author: hari@dasarpai.com (Dr. Hari Thapliyaal)
item.description:
Welcome to the Data Science & AI section of dasarpAI. Whether you are learning a new topic, preparing for interviews, or setting up tools on your machine, the paths below group related articles so you can start with a clear goal rather than browsing the full archive.

Curated learning paths—updated periodically when we add a major hub, series, or tool track. New posts still appear in All Data Science posts, tags, and categories; this page highlights where to begin.
